leadText: This is a list of episodes of Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl, which first aired between September 28, 2006 and September 9, 2010 in Japan and between June 4, 2007 and February 5, 2011 in , though the first three episodes were aired as a sneak peak on April 20, 2007. These episodes follow Ash Ketchum and in their Pokémon journey across the Sinnoh region, who are joined along the way by Ash's longtime friend .
